en.announcement_subtitle: A reviewable documentation update generated from repository and UI evidence.

en.title: Custom domains
en.summary: Custom domains are now managed from a workspace-level Domains page instead of a solution settings field.
en.benefit: This gives users one place to add domains, verify DNS ownership, check routing records, and bind active domains to services or published artifacts.
steps: Use Add domain to register the custom domain.
Publish the TXT verification record and A routing record shown on screen.
Wait until the domain is Active, then bind it to the service or published artifact that should use it.

examples.title: Prepare a branded app URL
examples.scenario: A workspace admin adds app.example.com, copies the TXT and A records into their DNS provider, then waits for the Active status before binding the domain.
examples.expected_result: The user can see the domain status, verification records, and binding options on the same page.

examples.title: Replace the stale guide path
examples.scenario: A documentation reviewer updates the old instruction that said to edit solution settings and points users to the workspace Domains page instead.
examples.expected_result: The guide matches the current interface and explains the verification and binding steps.
